TC-20/S20a.title: Web: a browser with the wrong date and another time zone shows the same counts and In Today set (UAT 3.8)
TC-20/S20a.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 16/16, 6 record-only. Context A real clock (host time zone) vs context B in Pacific/Honolulu with its clock +24 h and, second variant, on the next calendar day; seeds without notes (no billing job). Same Hospital counts (5/2/2/1) and rows, same Nursing Home counts (Today's Visits 2/1/1/0) and rows, same Today's Visits residents on A and B in both variants; B's visit changed nothing A sees. Recorded: B's stored session was dropped by its own clock and it signed in again through the form (known B33); the date line follows the device (A 'Friday, October 16, 2026', B next-calendar-day 'Saturday, October 17, 2026', Q4 / B18); the New Admission roll did not change A's rows.
